Contract ManageItemCRUDService::createItem(barcode: Integer,name: String,price: Real,stocknumber: Integer,orderprice: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		item: Item = Item.allInstance()->any(i|i.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		if item.oclIsUndefined() 
		then let newItem: Item in
		newItem.oclIsNew() and
		Item.allInstance()->includes(newItem) and
		newItem.Barcode = barcode and
		newItem.Name = name and
		newItem.Price = price and
		newItem.StockNumber = stocknumber and
		newItem.OrderPrice = orderprice and
		result = true 
		else result = false 
		endif
